text:
maria: Morning — final shiproom for py/ts SDK cutover in 45m. Quick status?
ben: QA: ran smoke tests against staging wheel and npm package. One flaky test left (auth header). Investigating.
deploy-bot: Release job started: build-ntfy-2009876543
dana: I saw an npm publish fail earlier due to rate limit; we retried and got 201. checksum looked ok.
ben: For python wheel, checksum mismatch on 2/5 uploads to test.pypi — re-uploaded with signed tag v1.14.0-rc2
alice: Are we planning to pin legacy sync client in changelog? It breaks our internal monorepo.
maria: Yes — we'll add deprecation note and automatic shim for 2 weeks. PD suggested.
sre-oncall: Reminder: change window is 14:00–17:00 UTC. No infra changes outside that.
dana: Rollback criteria: if canary error rate >3% for 10m or yanked package found, rollback immediately.
maria: Docs: add release notes: migration steps, sample code for new async client, link to deprecation doc.
ben: Publishing checklist: tag -> build -> verify checksums -> npm/pypi -> smoke -> canary -> promote
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 10% traffic: canary-v1.14.0-rc2. Observability: https://dash/ci/2009876543
ben: Canary logs show 502 spikes at 3:12 for one host, investigating whether retry policy triggered.
alice: If host outliers persist after 5m, failover to dedicated pool and revert canary.
maria: OK let's keep watch. I'll update shiproom notes and compile release notes. Ping in 15 for go/no-go.
dana: +1
